regime_context: Hong Kong theme leadership is narrow (4/17 eligible, absorption 0.47) and led by Diversified Miners, whose durability_bar (0.27) is weak and whose score is not eligible. The detector's only validated edge is drawdown/shake-out control via the absolute-trend gate, and gate_helps is true for this market, so the trend discipline has historically cut risk even without forecasting returns. No theme has a scorable ETF proxy except China Tech-related names, so most leans here are unscorable and low-conviction by construction.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Diversified Miners' durability_bar (currently 0.27) can rise above 0.5 while staying eligible — that would be the condition confirming a real trend handoff to Miners; if durability stays below 0.4 for another 15 trading days, the Miner leadership is likely noise rather than a durable handoff.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks are the only eligible theme in the top tier with a durable, high-breadth trend signature: durability_bar 0.68 (only one above the 0.62 readings of biotech and tech hardware), breadth 0.769 (highest among eligible names), and the absolute-trend gate is the one validated risk-control leg. Momentum rank is a focus lens, not alpha, but the combination of eligibility, durability, and breadth makes Banks the most coherent trend-following risk ON within the trend-discipline framework.
evidence: gate_helps: true validates the trend-discipline risk edge
theses.dissent: Banks have crowding_z 0.75 (highest in the set) and r10 of -0.0165 in the headline block, suggesting recent returns are flat-to-negative; a crowded, flat leader can chop sideways and bleed vol-adjusted returns even under the trend gate.

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: High-Dividend Blue Chips are eligible with a trend-tagged hurst and durability_bar 0.55, and low crowding (crowding_z -0.1). If the trend-gate discipline is the only validated edge, this name qualifies for a vol-aware allocation as a second, less-consensus INCOME-geared trend leg alongside Banks. Momentum rank is a focus lens, and there is no return forecast implied.
theses.dissent: Breadth is only 0.25, meaning the trend signature is concentrated in a small subset of constituents; a broad Hang Seng rally could lift Banks and Conglomerates far more than this concentrated income theme, causing relative underperformance.

theses.subject: China Tech & Internet
theses.thesis: China Tech & Internet is the only scorable theme with a proxy (3033.HK) and it sits at rank 13, ineligible, with hurst_tag mean-revert and durability_bar 0.16 — the trend discipline explicitly does NOT support risk-taking here. The absolute-trend gate is the validated edge, and this theme fails it. This is a storable, falsifiable directional lean of avoidance expressed within the trend framework.
theses.dissent: Mean-revert tags can signal that a theme is oversold and due for a snap-back; if policy or liquidity turns in China Tech, this is exactly the kind of beaten-down, low-durability theme that can rally hardest and fastest, leaving an underweight to miss a sharp move.

falsifier.text: 3033.HK outperforms the Hang Seng by 5% or more before 30 trading days elapse
